#### The shape of a small ReLU network

An [MLP](#def-feedforward-network) has one input $z \in \reals$,
one [hidden layer](#def-hidden-layer) of $L$ [ReLU](#def-relu) units,
and one output with no [activation function](#def-activation-function):

$$
\hat{y} = c + \sumto{i}{L} v_i \maxf{0, w_i z + b_i}.
$$

What does the graph of $\hat{y}$ against $z$ look like?

:::
